servicesIntro: Pricing starts at the numbers below. Call or schedule online for an official quote.

services.name: Full Detail
services.text: Exterior wash, clay and sealant, wheels and fender liners, door jambs and windows, and a full interior steam clean with UV protectant.

services.name: Paint Correction
services.text: Removes as many imperfections, surface scratches, swirls and marring as possible from your vehicle's finish.

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.text: A layer of liquid glass bonded to your paint. Think of it as a much stronger, longer-lasting wax that locks in the finish.

services.name: Paint Protection Film
services.text: A screen protector for your vehicle, cut precisely to fit. Top-tier protection for your surfaces.

services.name: Window Tinting
services.text: Tint installs for cars, trucks, SUVs and even watercraft.

services.name: Vessel Ceramic Coating
services.text: Two steps of gelcoat correction and your choice of coating, with trailer and wheels washed.

why.name: We teach you the car
why.text: Educating customers is the foundation of the business. You learn how to keep the finish looking its best.

why.name: Care for every vehicle
why.text: Each vehicle is treated as if it were our own.

why.name: Something for every budget
why.text: From a traditional inside-and-out detail to a full ceramic and PPF package.
